svg.text: Vehicle power and separate 3.3 V supplies
Selected controller: ESP32-S3 SuperMini. Baseline: ignition-switched power, no backup battery.
U1 / 5 V buck - TI 400 kHz reference circuit
C10/C11/C13: X7R ceramic; account for DC-bias derating.
Reference 5 V setting calculates 5.07 V nominal; 33 uH comes from TI's 6-65 V input example.
U1's 1 A output budget is shared by the controller and GPS branch.
Fixed 3.3 V / DRB VSON-8 / GPS rail
D20: Schottky reverse bypass / part TBD
D20: A = OUT, K = IN. U2 has no reverse-current limiting.
U2 pins 2/7 NC; may tie to GND per TI. Separate output from V3V3_FUEL.
Baseline has no post-key-off power, charger, battery, or ACC sense circuit.
Basis: pcb.md + pcb-components.md | 06 Oct 2026 | Amber = unresolved selection / validation
Schematic review drawing. No CAD ERC, physical-board verification, vehicle testing or fabrication release.
